title: Creative Director & Brand Strategist
description: Steer brand identity, multi-platform media production, motion design, digital advertising campaigns, and creative content strategy.
details:
### Role Overview
Lead brand storytelling, visual media production, digital advertising campaigns, and UI/UX creative directions.

### Key Responsibilities
- Conceptualize visual brand campaigns, video production, motion graphics, and interactive design.
- Lead cross-functional teams of visual designers, copywriters, and video editors.
- Collaborate with executive leadership on global brand positioning and digital media strategy.

### Requirements
- Bachelor’s or Master’s in Design, Fine Arts, Mass Communication, or Visual Arts.
- 6+ years in creative agency leadership or brand media production.
